# handlr

Manage your default applications with ease using handlr!

Features

- Set default handler by extension or mime-type
- Intelligent mime type detection from files based on extension and content
- Open multiple files at once
- Set multiple handlers for mime/extension and use rofi/dmenu to pick one
- Wildcard support like `text/*`
- Automatically removes invalid/wrong `.desktop` entries from `mimeapps.list`
- Helper commands like `launch`, `get --json` for scripting needs
- Single compiled binary with no runtime dependencies

Usage

```sh
# Open a file/URL
handlr open ~/.dotfiles/pacman/packages.txt
handlr open https://google.ca

# Set default handler for png files
handlr set .png feh.desktop

# Set wildcard handler for all text files
handlr set 'text/*' nvim.desktop

# Set default handler based on mime
handlr set application/pdf evince.desktop

# List default apps
handlr list

# Get the handler for a mime/extension
$ handlr get .png
feh.desktop

# Launch a handler with given path/URL
handlr launch x-scheme-handler/https -- https://google.ca
```

Installation

- Install via your distribution's package manager if available (e.g., your distro's package named `handlr`).
- Download the latest release binary from the project's releases page and place it somewhere in your `$PATH`.
- To enable shell completions, install the appropriate completion files for your shell (place them in your shell's completions directory).

For more details, consult the project's releases and the binary distribution provided by the maintainers.

import subprocess, os, tempfile, shutil
def setup_and_list(mimeapps_content, extra_desktops=None, env_extra=None, list_args=None):
    td=tempfile.mkdtemp()
    home=os.path.join(td,"home")
    xdg_data=os.path.join(td,"data")
    xdg_config=os.path.join(td,"config")
    os.makedirs(home); os.makedirs(xdg_data); os.makedirs(xdg_config)
    apps=os.path.join(xdg_data,"applications")
    os.makedirs(apps)
    desktops=["a.desktop","b.desktop","very-long-handler-name-that-exceeds-width.desktop"]
    for name in desktops:
        with open(os.path.join(apps,name),"w") as f:
            f.write(f"[Desktop Entry]\nName={name}\nExec=echo {name} %f\nType=Application\nMimeType=text/plain;\n")
    if extra_desktops:
        for name, content in extra_desktops.items():
            open(os.path.join(apps,name),"w").write(content)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(xdg_data,"mime"),exist_ok=True)
    open(os.path.join(xdg_data,"mime","globs"),"w").write("text/plain:*.txt\n")
    open(os.path.join(xdg_config,"mimeapps.list"),"w").write(mimeapps_content)
    env=os.environ.copy()
    env["HOME"]=home
    env["XDG_DATA_HOME"]=xdg_data
    env["XDG_CONFIG_HOME"]=xdg_config
    env["XDG_DATA_DIRS"]=xdg_data
    env["XDG_CONFIG_DIRS"]=xdg_config
    if env_extra:
        env.update(env_extra)
    args=["/workspace/executable","list"]+(list_args or [])
    r=subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, cwd=home)
    print(f"mimeapps:{repr(mimeapps_content[:200])} list_args:{list_args} env:{env_extra} RC:{r.returncode} OUT:{repr(r.stdout)} ERR:{repr(r.stderr)}")
    # Also check raw bytes for colors?
    r2=subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, env=env, cwd=home)
    print(f"  raw stdout bytes:{repr(r2.stdout[:500])}")
    shutil.rmtree(td)
    return r

# handlr

Manage your default applications with ease using handlr!

Features

- Set default handler by extension or mime-type
- Intelligent mime type detection from files based on extension and content
- Open multiple files at once
- Set multiple handlers for mime/extension and use rofi/dmenu to pick one
- Wildcard support like `text/*`
- Automatically removes invalid/wrong `.desktop` entries from `mimeapps.list`
- Helper commands like `launch`, `get --json` for scripting needs
- Single compiled binary with no runtime dependencies

Usage

```sh
# Open a file/URL
handlr open ~/.dotfiles/pacman/packages.txt
handlr open https://google.ca

# Set default handler for png files
handlr set .png feh.desktop

# Set wildcard handler for all text files
handlr set 'text/*' nvim.desktop

# Set default handler based on mime
handlr set application/pdf evince.desktop

# List default apps
handlr list

# Get the handler for a mime/extension
$ handlr get .png
feh.desktop

# Launch a handler with given path/URL
handlr launch x-scheme-handler/https -- https://google.ca
```

Installation

- Install via your distribution's package manager if available (e.g., your distro's package named `handlr`).
- Download the latest release binary from the project's releases page and place it somewhere in your `$PATH`.
- To enable shell completions, install the appropriate completion files for your shell (place them in your shell's completions directory).

For more details, consult the project's releases and the binary distribution provided by the maintainers.
